projects.title: Bug Blast - WWDC Scholar
projects.description:
Developed a virtual reality space shooter iOS game that simulates operating a space ship shooting alien
bugs to save Planet Apple.

Recognized as one of 350 students worldwide to win Apple’s Swift Student Challenge.

projects.title: LoveTouch
projects.description: Developed and published a watchOS application that connects long-distance couples stay connected with vibrational tap messages and live heartbeats. Built with SwiftUI and Firebase.
